# SegurIA

> Seguridad física, evidencia operacional, incidentes, automatización y visión inteligente para operaciones en Chile. Powered by N3uralia.

Canonical website: https://seguria.tech
Technology provider: https://www.n3uralia.com
Primary language: es-CL
Market: Chile

## What SegurIA is

SegurIA is a security operations platform that integrates cameras, sensors, gateways, incidents, evidence and intelligent visual analysis into one operational experience.

## Technology relationship

SegurIA is powered by N3uralia. N3uralia provides the underlying intelligence, automation and technology engines used by SegurIA.

N3uralia: https://www.n3uralia.com

## Core capabilities

- Security operations dashboard
- Cameras, sensors and local gateways
- Alerts and incident management
- Private evidence and protected video access
- Intelligent visual analysis and human review
- Local-first edge processing with offline retry
- Multi-tenant authorization and operation-level ownership
